description: Custom keys Chat puts in the content of an agent's m.room.message events. Chat owns this file; consumers (Windy Mobile, Windy Agent, Windy Word) vendor a snapshot and add a drift test. Nobody writes these keys independently of this contract.
applies_to: m.room.message events sent by an agent's Matrix account in its DM room

uk.windypro.model.meaning: The model id Windy Mind actually SERVED for this reply, taken from Mind's response (x-mind-model / response model). Never the model that was requested.
absent_when: Mind did not say which model answered
tool-result lines (Sent / Done / Ready to send)
owner notices and system lines (pause/restore notes, greetings, /model confirmations)
messages not written by an agent
uk.windypro.model.consumer_rule: Render a small label under the bubble when present; render nothing when absent. Never infer a model from anything else.

uk.windypro.raw.meaning: true when the reply was produced in Pure/raw mode. NOT written yet; no consumer should build on it until this file marks it live.

uk.windypro.fallback.meaning: The reply came from a Mind-issued fallback floor (MD14 route table) because Windy Mind was down or too slow. uk.windypro.model on the same event still names the model that actually answered; this key never replaces it.
absent_when: the reply came from Windy Mind normally (the common case)
tool-result lines, owner notices and system lines
the writer does not run the MD14 helper yet (no writer today)
uk.windypro.fallback.consumer_rule: When present, show a small 'backup brain' label next to the model label. Never infer it from the model id. Ignore unknown values.

writer: services/agent-roster/lib/model-pref.js replyModelKey() (agent-roster); the same contract applies to Windy Agent's own Matrix replies for Windy Zero ONLY by vendoring this file.
change_rule: Add keys or change meaning only by editing this file in a Chat PR and notifying Windy Hub, Windy Agent and Windy Mobile BEFORE merge. Never rename or repurpose a live key.
